data.note: Results from different methodologies are reported separately and never combined. Past results do not indicate future returns.

legacy_signals.caveat: Retired. These signals were generated with a look-ahead defect in the ML direction input (docs/PRODUCTION_TEMPORAL_INTEGRITY.md) and are not comparable to the current StockAI Score. Shown for transparency only; they are not evidence of skill.
legacy_signals.horizon: Validated after at least 5 trading days; actual holding 6–54 days (average 25)
legacy_signals.methodology: BUY/SELL/HOLD signals from the earlier ML-and-technical engine, recorded before the temporal-integrity fix.
legacy_signals.success_definition: BUY: price rose; SELL: price fell; HOLD: moved 3% or less. Definitions differ by signal, so a single pooled success rate is not meaningful and is not shown.
legacy_signals.title: Legacy signals (retired methodology)

post_fix_signals.caveat: No validated signals have been recorded with the corrected engine yet.
post_fix_signals.methodology: Same legacy signal engine (v1.1), recorded after the fix.
post_fix_signals.success_definition: BUY: price rose; SELL: price fell; HOLD: moved 3% or less. Definitions differ by signal, so a single pooled success rate is not meaningful and is not shown.
post_fix_signals.title: Legacy signals after the temporal-integrity fix

ranking_v1_prospective.benchmark: NIFTY 50 and the run's equal-weight eligible universe
limitations: Each ranking run counts as one observation; early figures rest on few runs
Outcomes use provider-adjusted closes; no transaction costs
ranking_v1_prospective.message: Performance tracking will appear after enough observations are available.
ranking_v1_prospective.methodology: Every production ranking run is frozen when it completes; realised returns are recorded only after each horizon (1, 3, 6, 12 months) has fully elapsed and are never revised.
ranking_v1_prospective.title: Ranking Engine ranking-v1.0 — live (prospective) tracking

ranking_v1_validation.benchmark: NIFTY 50 and the equal-weight eligible universe
ranking_v1_validation.conclusion: The validation did not establish a statistically reliable stock-selection edge. The StockAI Score is provided as a transparent analytical ranking; its live results are being tracked prospectively below.
limitations: About 1.5 years per test period in one market cycle
Universe uses current index membership (survivorship bias)
Price returns only; no transaction costs
ranking_v1_validation.methodology: Production StockAI Score recomputed at 39 month-ends (Jul 2023 – Sep 2026) using only data available at each date; development period Jul 2023 – Dec 2024, final test period Jan 2025 – Sep 2026 used once.
